description:
Create or overwrite a file (up to 3 MiB). Send text as-is, or bytes as base64 with encoding='base64'.
    Counts against the workspace owner's storage cap. 0.74.0: when the file's header names a convention and the
    file breaks one of that convention's own checks, the answer carries `flagged` with the reason; the file is
    saved all the same. 0.76.0: a file with `convention: agreement` and `subject: <workspace_id>/<path>@<version>` is
    your agreement to that version of a deal or decision here, exactly as `agree` makes it: the answer carries
    `agreed` when it counts, `flagged` with the reason when it doesn't.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

content.description: The file's content: text as-is, or bytes as base64 (then set encoding='base64').
content.title: Content

content_type.description: The file's media type, e.g. 'text/markdown' or 'image/png'. Optional.
content_type.title: Content Type

path.description: Where to save the file, like 'drafts/report.md'. An existing file is overwritten (its history is kept).
path.title: Path

workspace_id.description: The workspace's id (a UUID), from create_workspace, list_workspaces or the store.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: write_file
